name: Prayer to Elune
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Will you assist me, mortal? Will you find the prayer to Elune?

As I stated, the prayer was etched onto a golden tablet. One of these idol worshipping scoundrels must have it on their person.

If you do recover my prayer, take it to Astarii Starseeker in Darnassus. It matters little that my faith has been rekindled after the countless malevolent actions that I have taken against this world and its inhabitants, but my prayer must be heard. Absolution is the last thing I expect.
narrative.objectives: Find the Prayer to Elune and take it to Astarii Starseeker in Darnassus.
narrative.offerRewardText: Elune smiles upon you this eve, adventurer. You have returned a lost soul to her. Please accept this as a token of our gratitude.
narrative.requestItemsText: What brings you to the Temple of the Moon, adventurer?
